To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) ANN models can be trained for the prediction of biological activity of compounds at mGluRs and (ii) these models can be applied to virtual screening of large compound databases for the identification of novel mGluR PAMs.
the use of virtual HTS and ANN-based QSAR models can be used to efficiently and cost-effectively identify compounds with desired biological activity.
we have developed a novel virtual high-throughput screening approach for the identification of novel mGluR ligands.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of novel PAMs for mGluR using virtual screening and QSAR.
the development of novel, efficient computational tools for the identification of mGluR modulators.
the identification and optimization of new mGluR modulators using a combined virtual screening and experimental screening approach.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the ANN models are capable of predicting biological activity with a high degree of reliability and that these models can be used as a tool in virtual screening for the identification of novel active compounds.
the virtual screening approach described herein is capable of identifying new mGluR modulators with a hit rate that is 25-fold greater than that of the original experimental screening data set.
the ANN models developed in this work have the ability to identify novel active compounds from large chemical databases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of QSAR models trained with a large set of experimental data can be successfully applied to identify new active compounds from large virtual screens of commercially available substances.
virtual high-throughput screening can be a powerful tool in the identification of new active compounds.
the ANN models developed for mGluR subtype 5 (5) PAM activity are robust and can be used to identify novel mGluR(5) PAMs in a high-throughput fashion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
virtual screening using ANN models is an effective tool for identifying novel mGluR PAMs.
the combination of HTS with virtual high-throughput screening is a promising approach for the identification of novel mGluR ligands.
virtual screening using ANN models is an efficient and effective method for identifying new mGluR ligands.
